issue: docs/coverage-status.md, the six slots the engine had no axis for

landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures the baseline it moved.

what_landed: Sivir's On the Hunt pays 0.5s off Q, W and E's LIVE cooldowns per basic attack for its own 8/10/12s window, which is the sourced combat effect that kept R out_of_scope.
why: The refund is sourced twice and agreeing, so no number here is a literal: the cached R prose says the attacks 'reduce her basic abilities' current cooldowns by 0.5 seconds each', and the tracked binary's SivirR carries an AttackCooldownRefund DataValue of 0.5 on every rank. The module reads the binary through binary_roots rather than pinning a constant.

The shape is new and it is NOT stack_scaled_cooldown: that is a slot's rule about its own cooldown, and this grant is authored on R and shortens Q, W and E. swing_cooldown_refund is authored on the GRANTING row and names the slots it refunds.

Navori Flickerblade's share and this flat refund ride the SAME attack, so cast_schedule walks them together in one pass. Two sequential walks would each charge the elapsed time for the same attacks and place every recast late. Which reducer lands first on one attack is not sourced; the share goes first, so a build holding both gets the smaller reading rather than the larger, and the module cannot choose.

Measured at twenty seconds, level 18, Kraken Slayer and Berserker's Greaves: Q moves from 0 / 8.25 / 16.5 to 0 / 5.22 / 10.441 / 17.691, W from 0.25 / 12.25 to 0.25 / 7.35 / 16.35, E from 0.25 / 18.25 to 0.25 / 10.901. The third Q gap is 7.25s rather than 5.22s because the hunt ends at 12.25s, which is the window intersection rather than a flat multiplier.
rotation.autos_per_second was gated on holding Navori, so the kit refund walked at zero attacks a second and fell closed to the unrefunded cooldown, silently. The gate now names both readers.

qualifying_population.rule: Sivir R is the only row in the tree declaring swing_cooldown_refund, and the scheduler refuses a second owner rather than combining two flat refunds on one attack, which nothing sources.
